name: object-storage-s3
description: Bun-native S3-compatible object storage for AWS S3 or MinIO with a StorageService and presigned URLs.
instructions: Start MinIO for local dev:  docker compose -f infra/docker/docker-compose.yml -f infra/docker/minio.compose.yml up -d
Store an object:  curl -XPUT localhost:5002/storage/hello -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"content":"hi"}'
For AWS S3: set STORAGE_PROVIDER=aws, remove S3_ENDPOINT, set S3_FORCE_PATH_STYLE=false and real credentials/bucket.
